script: Spread and total were not saved for PHI@JAX, so this is form-only: over weeks 2-4 PHI split the ground game T.Bigsby 27/88, S.Barkley 21/99, J.Hurts 14/59 and W.Shipley 13/47 while J.Hurts sat at -0.21 EPA/dropback vs blitz (n=53) and -0.02 with no blitz. JAX is the side with a functioning offense, T.Lawrence +0.43 EPA/dropback when not blitzed (n=33) against a PHI blitz rate of only 20%, and B.Tuten already at 45 carries for 211 yards, so the lean is JAX rushing into PHI's 4.16 YPC front rather than a shootout we can price.
who_goes_off: B.Tuten is the JAX back who matches the hole, 45 carries for 211 yards (4.69 YPC) plus 6 targets for 32 yards over weeks 2-4, into a PHI defense that has allowed 4.16 YPC and 9 runs of 10+ in 4 games. B.Strange is the receiving complement at 15 targets, 144 yards and 107 air yards (48.0 per game), while P.Washington's 20 targets produced just 145 yards on 265 air yards.
weak_spot: JAX leaks over the middle at 10.86 YPA on 22 attempts versus 8.06 left (51 att) and 7.94 right (65 att), with 16 passes of 20+ on 148 attempts, but the JAX run front is the strength at 3.41 YPC and only 5 runs of 10+. PHI's hole is the run at 4.16 YPC and 9 runs of 10+, while pass YPA is compressed at 6.97 left, 6.39 middle and 6.41 right with only 11 explosives on 144 attempts.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for PHI@JAX, so no absence is assigned: Z.Ertz logged only 6 targets for 22 yards and 35 air yards over weeks 2-4, and D.Goedert is priced at 41.5 with zero targets in that log, which is a usage gap not a declared injury. JAX's target order is intact at P.Washington 20, B.Strange 15, J.Meyers 13 and Bri.Thomas 12, with nobody missing to reallocate carries away from B.Tuten's 45.
qb_vs_blitz: J.Hurts is worse when blitzed at -0.21 EPA/dropback (n=53) than the -0.02 with no blitz, and JAX blitzes 26%, so about one in four Hurts dropbacks lands in the bad split. T.Lawrence is the opposite, -0.10 vs blitz (n=33) but +0.43 with no blitz, and PHI's 20% blitz rate leaves most of his dropbacks in that +0.43 state, which feeds JAX chain-movers and does not help PHI's committee against a 3.41 YPC JAX run defense.

picks.why: W.Shipley has 13 carries for 47 rush yards over weeks 2-4 (15.7 per game) behind T.Bigsby (27), S.Barkley (21) and J.Hurts (14), and JAX allows 3.41 YPC with only 5 runs of 10+. Eight carries at that 3.41 YPC is 27 yards, still under 33.5, and the carry split gives no path to a doubled role.

P.Washington's weeks 2-4 line is 20 targets, 145 yards and 265 air yards, 48.3 rec yards per game on a 13.3 air-yards-per-target profile, against a 62 number. PHI allows 6.97/6.39/6.41 YPA left/middle/right and only 11 passes of 20+ on 144 attempts, so 6.7 targets at that ~6.6 YPA lands near 44, not 62.
